title: eludite.editor.remove_and_sort_usings input
description: Remove and Sort Usings (Edit > IntelliSense > Remove and Sort Usings, Ctrl+R, Ctrl+G; brief 0069): the document's leading using (C#) or Imports (Visual Basic) directives are sorted, System namespaces first, and the language server's fix that removes unnecessary ones is applied when it offers one. One or two undo steps.

path.description: Absolute path of an open document. Omit to act on the active document.
